author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
KILL TEAM: Nemesis Operatives is a sort-of 'Dungeon Master's Guide' to playing linked narrative or one-off Joint Operations of Solo and Cooperative Kill Team. You can both use Nemesis Operatives (big guys like Dreadnaughts or Chaos Hellbrutes) in your team to fight other Nemesis Threats or track them down to their lairs in a base assault. You also get faction-specific traits and a whole slew of NPO datasheets for the core antagonist 'goons' to populate the map. Let's check it out!

#40kKillTeam

author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Need a quick way to fill up your battlefield of 6x4' Rank and Flank games? Mantic has put together this 'all at once' terrain pack intended for Fantasy game players (like Kings of War) to have a one-box solution to getting terrain on the table. Cardstock buildings, neoprene terrain zones and PVC and Vacumformed hills all sit in the same box. Let's check it out.

Big thanks to Mantic for the complimentary copy to review. 

Available HERE: https://www.manticgames.com/terraincratebattlefields/fantasy-battlefield-pack/
